summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a stylelint configuration but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled ~727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-array shuffling, hex identifiers, single-line body) and has no relationship to stylelint configuration. Because the payload is executed under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node, its behavior is opaque to Node-based tooling and static review. Installing the package triggers this chain automatically via the npm preinstall lifecycle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
